mc-elk-011.front: Minimum tine size in BC rules?
mc-elk-011.back: At least 2.5 cm long and longer than it is wide (99%, page 4).

Left: a low wide bump inside a 2.5 cm box is NOT a tine. Right: a narrow spike that reaches the top of the box IS a tine. Width is measured 2.5 cm down from the tip. Synopsis definitions page.">

mc-elk-025.front: Two lungs hit: how far does a bull usually go?
mc-elk-025.back: Usually down within about 100 yards (91 m); one lung, hundreds of metres (65%).

mc-elk-027.front: Why can elk do well on poor range?
mc-elk-027.back: A bigger rumen for their body size than mule deer (80%).

mc-elk-044.front: Can you use elk urine from Alberta as a lure?
mc-elk-044.back: No. Elk parts or derivatives from outside BC may not be used for hunting (99%, page 11).

mc-elk-056.back: Sparring: equal bulls push and twist, no winner. Rut fights: serious, sometimes goring (90%).
